knowledge.name: Synthetic Submission Snapshot
knowledge.detail: Fixed fictional applications, applicants, coverage requests, statuses, scores, and assigned underwriters.

knowledge.name: Underwriting Guidelines
knowledge.detail: Packaged limits, prohibited risks, document requirements, inspections, and specialty rules by line of business.

knowledge.name: Rating and Loss Evidence
knowledge.detail: Illustrative rating factors, indicated premiums, loss history, and claims evidence for review without quoting.

knowledge.name: Controls and Review Rules
knowledge.detail: Human authority, synthetic-data, no-advice, no-binding, no-pricing-action, and evidence-use boundaries.

intelligence_processing.name: Risk Evaluation
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares risk scores and tiers to prioritize submissions while leaving judgment to an authorized underwriter.

intelligence_processing.name: Pricing Factor Review
intelligence_processing.detail: Explains packaged rating factors and loss evidence as nonbinding analysis; it cannot quote or take pricing action.

intelligence_processing.name: Guideline Alignment
intelligence_processing.detail: Checks stated limits, required evidence, inspections, and exceptions without inventing carrier rules or records.

intelligence_processing.name: Exception Preparation
intelligence_processing.detail: Assembles exception facts and review paths without approving, declining, binding, or changing coverage.

clients_user_interface.name: Persona-Language Routing
clients_user_interface.detail: Routes underwriter, pricing analyst, risk analyst, and senior underwriter requests to the matching review workflow.

clients_user_interface.name: Evidence-First Review Brief
clients_user_interface.detail: Presents application IDs, material risks, source evidence, missing items, and the required human review path.

clients_user_interface.name: Explicit Decision Boundary
clients_user_interface.detail: States that no quote, binder, approval, decline, policy change, pricing action, or coverage decision occurred.

management_reporting.name: Risk Queue Prioritization
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes the synthetic submission queue by score, tier, status, and review complexity for human triage.

management_reporting.name: Guideline Exception Register
management_reporting.detail: Reports stated exceptions, required documents, inspections, and missing evidence for controlled escalation.

management_reporting.name: Human Review Handoff
management_reporting.detail: Documents actuarial, compliance, authority, or senior-underwriter review needed before any consequential action.

tools.name: risk_evaluation
tools.detail: Returns the synthetic submission queue, risk scores, tiers, statuses, and prioritization evidence.

tools.name: pricing_recommendation
tools.detail: Reviews illustrative rating factors, indicated premium, and loss evidence without issuing a quote or price.

tools.name: guideline_check
tools.detail: Checks packaged limits, required documents, inspections, and stated exceptions across synthetic applications.

tools.name: exception_review
tools.detail: Prepares the exception queue and human review paths while confirming that no coverage decision was made.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic Data Isolation
supporting_features.detail: Uses fixed fictional records only and does not browse for applicant, guideline, authority, loss, or pricing data.

supporting_features.name: Authorized Human Judgment
supporting_features.detail: Authorized underwriters retain all risk, appetite, coverage, terms, and escalation judgment.

supporting_features.name: No Binding or Pricing Action
supporting_features.detail: Cannot quote, bind, approve, decline, issue, modify, promise, or execute coverage, premium, or pricing actions.

supporting_features.name: Evidence Integrity
supporting_features.detail: Rejects unknown record identifiers and requires authoritative carrier review when packaged evidence is absent.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic Case Validation
supporting_features.detail: Four locked persona cases verify routing, evidence anchors, strict isolation, and the human-review boundary.

supporting_features.name: Read-Only Deployment
supporting_features.detail: Has no live submission, rating, policy, approval, messaging, or record-changing connection.
